entries.en: We're going to a ripper, OK? A few minutes away. Will you hang in there?
entries.ro: Mergem la un ripper, OK? La câteva minute. Reziști?

entries.en: Shit... If he dies, I don't get paid.
entries.ro: Căcat... Dacă moare, nu mai văd banii.

entries.en: Get out of the car. Come on, now!
Not my problem. Did my part.
entries.en_m: Not my problem. I did my part.
entries.ro: Nu-i treaba mea. Mi-am făcut partea.
